What happens to my YouTube when I die?

By the Afterkeep research team · Reviewed on 15 Oct 2026

Short answer: YouTube channels belong to a Google Account, so Google's rules apply. With Inactive Account Manager you can share YouTube data with up to 10 trusted contacts after a period of inactivity, or have the account deleted. Without a plan, family use Google's deceased-user request. Google never shares passwords, and inactive accounts can be deleted after 2 years.

Key facts

  • Governed by your Google Account
  • Inactive Account Manager can share YouTube data
  • No passwords shared
  • 2-year inactivity deletion can apply

How do I prepare my YouTube account?

  1. Set up Inactive Account Manager and include YouTube in the data you share.
  2. For a brand or business channel, add a trusted person through YouTube channel permissions now.
  3. Download your videos with Google Takeout and keep an offline copy.
  4. After a death, family use Google's deceased-user request to close the account or ask for data.

Read the official policy ↗

What documents do heirs need?

  • Death certificate and the requester's ID for Google's deceased-user request
  • Possibly further legal documents for data

How long does it take?

Shared data is released only after your chosen inactivity period. Deceased-user requests have no published timeframe.

What can't be recovered?

  • Login access to the channel
  • Everything, if the account is deleted for inactivity or closed before data is requested

Frequently asked questions

What happens to my YouTube when I die?

YouTube channels belong to a Google Account, so Google's rules apply. With Inactive Account Manager you can share YouTube data with up to 10 trusted contacts after a period of inactivity, or have the account deleted. Without a plan, family use Google's deceased-user request. Google never shares passwords, and inactive accounts can be deleted after 2 years.

Will my YouTube channel stay up after I die?

It stays until the account is closed or deleted. Under Google's policy, personal accounts inactive for 2 years can be deleted.

Can someone take over my YouTube channel?

Google won't hand over a login. Add trusted people through channel permissions while you're alive.

Can I give someone my videos automatically?

Yes. Include YouTube in Inactive Account Manager.
